newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Clayton Williams FY97 up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Clayton Williams FY97 up.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Wednesday it raised its earnings estimate for Clayton Williams Energy Inc's fiscal 1997 earnings to $1.34 a share from $1.20, citing its record earnings in the fourth quarter of 1996 of $0.77 versus an operating loss of $0.07 a year ago.
-- Hanifen said the latest quarterly results were well above its estimate of $0.60 and the consensus of $0.54.
-- Clayton Williams is expected to see higher-than-expected oil prices and lower-than-expected expenses in 1997, Hanifen said.
-- Clayton Williams is an oil and gas exploration company.
-- Its shares were trading down 3/4 Wednesday at 12-5/8.
